title: ClaimDecision
description: Output of the three-signal concordance and the Policy Agent: the named outcome, recommended action, policy-cited adjuster brief, and multilingual farmer messages.

outcome_class.description: Concordance table outcome class (deterministic, computed by core/ConcordanceTable).

recommended_action.description: Deterministic action mapped from the outcome class.

failure_mode.description: Human-readable explanation of why the index and plot diverged, or null when no gap exists.

cited_clause_ids.description: Policy clause IDs referenced in the adjuster brief, e.g. ['4.2.1', '5.3'].

citations_validated_by_code.description: True if every cited_clause_id was found in the policy index by deterministic code.

adjuster_brief.description: Markdown-formatted brief for the human adjuster, citing policy clauses.

farmer_messages.description: Multilingual farmer-facing messages (at least English is always present).
